observations: Black PlayStation 4 console with 'PS4' and 'SONY' branding visible on the top surface.
Two controllers are shown: one silver DualShock 4 and one camouflage-patterned DualShock 4.
The console is resting on a wooden surface with artificial grass visible at the bottom.
Watermark 'EASY GAMES & GADGETS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center of the image.
The console appears to be in a clean, unused state.

claims.evidence: The console is a standard PS4 model, not a Pro model which has a different form factor.
The console cannot be verified to be hacked without a jailbreak tool or a working homebrew environment.
The firmware version cannot be read from the console without a diagnostic tool.
No games are shown on the console screen or in the system library.
The camouflage controller is a third-party skin; the authenticity of the original controller cannot be confirmed.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a hardware failure.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The console may be a lower-spec model (e.g., 500GB instead of 1TB).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Storage' screen showing the total capacity.

risks.risk: The console may be a 'hacked' version (e.g., a jailbreak) rather than a standard firmware.
risks.proof: A video showing the console connected to a computer and running a homebrew application.

risks.risk: The camouflage controller may be a third-party skin rather than an original controller.
risks.proof: A photo of the controller with the skin removed.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Photo of the 'System Storage' screen showing the total storage capacity.
Photo of the 'Settings' screen showing the firmware version.
Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the console model.
Photo of the controller with the camouflage skin removed.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
